system.description:
Grants the ability to read minds and transmit thoughts both passively and aggressively.

  • Level 1: Sense strong surface thoughts; transmit basic feelings
  • Level 2: Read ordinary surface thoughts; send words/images; converse with other telepaths
  • Level 3: Share sensory input or read thoughts from a group (up to 10); speak to group or send strong image
  • Level 4: Invade mind to extract memories (opposed roll); instinctive touch reading; speak to small group
  • Level 5: Read surface thoughts of anyone nearby; probe repressed memories; speak to crowd (25)
  • Level 6: Automatically read thoughts and sensory input from touch; alter memories; speak to throng (50)
